issue_context.title: Bug: Stuck on loading when starting on Windows logon
issue_context.body:
### Description

When Files is configured to launch on Windows startup, it fails. It stays stuck on the loading page.

### Steps To Reproduce

Activate launch on Windows startup.

### Requirements

Fix the bug.

### Files Version

3.0.1.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 Pro 23H2 22635.2700

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/13287860/debug.log)
